name: Dublin
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Dublin, GA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Dublin, Georgia for 2026: tree lighting, Santa, a parade, a light display and The Nutcracker, with dates and prices checked.
lede: Dublin lights its downtown tree at Founders Park, welcomes Santa at the Visitor Center and on Jackson Street, and stages a volunteer-run Nutcracker at Theatre Dublin.
celebrates: Visit Dublin Georgia lists the season's events, from the Holly Jolly Welcome at the Visitor Information Center on December 1 to Jingle and Mingle in Downtown Dublin on December 4, when the Christmas tree at Founders Park is lit and Santa takes photos at the historic Dublin Carnegie. The Exchange Club of Dublin presents a nighttime parade of more than a mile on December 5, the Brookdale Drive Christmas Light Display glows nightly through January 1, and The Nutcracker fills Theatre Dublin on December 12 and 13.
lastyear: We did not find a dated 2025 recap for Dublin's holiday events. Visit Dublin Georgia describes the Brookdale Drive display as shining since 2016, the Nutcracker as celebrating its 22nd year and the Exchange Club's parade as a nighttime tradition, so this page leans on the 2026 listings from the tourism bureau and the hosts.
facts: Dublin's tree lighting takes place at Founders Park, tucked next to Vallant Bank in Downtown Dublin, and Santa's photo-op is across the street at the historic Dublin Carnegie. Theatre Dublin stages The Nutcracker with a cast of more than 75 and gives a free showing each year to thousands of school children. The Visitor Information Center at 102 Travel Center Boulevard sits off Exit 51.
trains: Dublin does not run a holiday train that we found for 2026. Families who want a Christmas ride can take a carriage down Madison Street during Jingle and Mingle on December 4, listed at $30, or look at the Milledgeville trolley rides to Santa's Workshop, about 50 miles northwest.
traditions: Cookies, cocoa, Santa photos and a Porch Party at the Dublin Visitor Information Center on December 1.
The Founders Park tree lighting, Santa photos at the Dublin Carnegie and carriage rides on December 4.
The Exchange Club's nighttime parade of more than a mile on December 5.
A homegrown walk-through light display open nightly December 1 to January 1.
A volunteer-run production at Theatre Dublin on December 12 and 13, in its 22nd year.
kidfact: Dublin's Nutcracker has a cast of more than 75 and an onstage blizzard.
faq: Dublin holds the Holly Jolly Welcome on December 1, lights the Founders Park tree during Jingle and Mingle on December 4, hosts an Exchange Club parade on December 5 and stages The Nutcracker at Theatre Dublin on December 12 and 13.
When is the Dublin Christmas parade in 2026?
The Exchange Club of Dublin's parade starts at 6 pm on Saturday, December 5, 2026, and stretches over a mile through the Bellevue and Downtown Historic Districts.
Where can kids meet Santa in Dublin?
Kids can meet Santa at the Holly Jolly Welcome on December 1, at the Dublin Carnegie after the tree lighting on December 4 and at the end of the Christmas parade on December 5.
Are there free Christmas events in Dublin?
Yes. The Holly Jolly Welcome and the Christmas parade are free, and the Brookdale Drive display and Jingle and Mingle list no admission price.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Dublin for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from December 1 (Holly Jolly Welcome and the Brookdale Drive Christmas Light Display) through January 1, 2027 (the Brookdale Drive lights), with Jingle and Mingle (December 4), the Dublin Christmas Parade (December 5) and The Nutcracker at Theatre Dublin (December 12 and 13) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Dublin

  • Parades and tree lightings: the Founders Park tree lighting at Jingle and Mingle (December 4) and the Dublin Christmas Parade (December 5)
